body_markdown:
Renters know that[Manhattan](https://www.renthop.com/nyc/manhattan-apartments) is expensive. Summer is ending and median prices for an apartment in the borough has increased again to[$5,495](https://www.renthop.com/average-rent-in/manhattan-new-york-ny) this month. Renters can browse the best Manhattan listings in October of 2026 for under $3,750 to find competitive rental opportunities.


During the summer, renters had plenty of competition from other renters for great apartments. However, now that we’re slowly approaching fall, renters must act quickly to take advantage of the available inventory due to competition from other renters. The following Manhattan listings in October of 2026 for rent under $3,750 offer laundry access in the building, private backyard access, decorative fireplaces, and more.


---


## Best Manhattan listings in October of 2026 under $3,750


### [1. 101 Lexington Avenue #3B](https://www.renthop.com/listings/101-lexington-avenue-3b/3b/77103501/show)


Neighborhood:[Kips Bay](https://www.renthop.com/apartments-for-rent/kips-bay-new-york-ny)


Price: $3,450


Size: 1 Bed, 1 Bath


Percentage Below: 25.65%


First up this month, is a one bedroom apartment that’s immediately available for move-in in Kips Bay. The landlord is currently offering one month free on a lease that ends in either 4/30/28 or 5/31/28. Tenants are responsible for covering renter’s insurance, utilities, and cable/internet service. Unit features lots of exposed brick and a fireplace!


### [2. 228 East 36th Street #1A](https://www.renthop.com/listings/228-east-36th-street/1a/77179218/show)


Neighborhood:[Murray Hill](https://www.renthop.com/apartments-for-rent/murray-hill-new-york-ny)


Price: $3,000


Size: 1 Bed, 1 Bath


Percentage Below: 43.67%


This next unit located in Murray Hill comes in a railroad layout. It is available for immediate move in. The unit’s bathroom comes with built in shelving, vanity, and a soaking tub. The landlord is open to pets!

### [3. 106 Fulton Street #13D](https://www.renthop.com/listings/106-fulton/13d/77144232/show)


Neighborhood:[Financial District](https://www.renthop.com/apartments-for-rent/financial-district-new-york-ny)


Price: $3,750


Size: 1 Bed Flex 2, 1 Bath


Percentage Below: 31.09%


Next up, don’t miss out on this Financial District one bedroom apartment which can be converted into a two bedroom. This unit comes with high ceilings, hardwood floors, a dishwasher, and laundry facilities in the basement. Best yet, there is a live-in super which makes issues a breeze to deal with.


### [4. 211 West 80th Street #1C](https://www.renthop.com/listings/211-west-80th-street/1c/77217576/show)


Neighborhood:[Upper West Side](https://www.renthop.com/apartments-for-rent/upper-west-side-new-york-ny)


Price: $3,550


Size: 1 Bed, 1 Bath


Percentage Below: 30.39%


Next up, this charming one bedroom apartment in the Upper West Side is available for immediate move in. This unit offers a comfortable layout, decorative fireplace, and plenty of exposed brick walls. Although there are no laundry facilities in the building, there is a laundromat right across the street.


### [5. 320 East 93rd Street #1D](https://www.renthop.com/listings/320-east-93rd-street/1d/77189861/show)


Neighborhood:[Upper East Side](https://www.renthop.com/apartments-for-rent/upper-east-side-new-york-ny)


Price: $3,200


Size: 1 Bed, 1 Bath


Percentage Below: 32.63%


Last but not least, this next junior 1 bedroom unit in the Upper East Side is a must see. The unit has its own private backyard, recessed lighting, exposed brick, stainless steel appliances, and more. The bedroom can accommodate a Queen-size bed and there’s plenty of windows in the unit.


## Methodology


Released on a monthly basis, the RentHop Best Deal series aims to provide renters with useful market insights and a chance to identify rental gems currently available on the market. These Manhattan best deals are hand-selected by the team at[RentHop](https://www.renthop.com/apartments-for-rent/new-york-ny) based on a few factors, including layout, apartment size, features, and, more importantly, price.


Note that, given the fast-paced nature of the rental market in New York, certain listings may receive applications and be taken off the market within days. If you are interested in scheduling a showing or have further questions, please make sure to submit an inquiry via the inquiry submission form located on the listing page.
